programmes.d: Across seven rivers, mountains, and forests, 12 strongmen open a new season of Strongman Champions League for 2015!
The strongest men of the world face a new challenge where they must battle it out in front of athletes from the world of fitness and bodybuilding.

Welcome to the land of canals, windmills, bicycles - and strongmen. 14 strongmen compete for title of The Netherlands. Events feature Truck Pulling, Flipping Tires, Wheels of Conan, Stones of Atlas and many, many more.
Squadre provenienti da Francia, Stati Uniti, Regno Unito, Italia, Israele, Germania, Repubblica Ceca e Svizzera competono per i loro paesi per diventare il campione del mondo di World Chase Tag!
Squadre provenienti da Francia, Stati Uniti, Regno Unito, Italia, Israele, Germania, Repubblica Ceca e Svizzera competono per i loro paesi per diventare il campione del mondo di World Chase Tag!

In the land of lakes, forests and white nights, only one can be strongest. World strongest Viking and ‘The Mountain’ from Game of Thrones and Big Z - Zydrunas Savickas, one of strongest people on Earth, compete for the title.

After 250 competitions, one Strongman champion title and breaking a lot of a Guinness World Records, one of the most successful and popular strongmen in the world battles for the last time in his fantastic career.
In Riga, the capital of Latvia, some of the most populars strongmen in the league battle in the keg toss, power stairs and Conan wheel.

‘The Mountain’ Hafthor Julius Björnsson is back in Croatia, where some of Game of Thrones series is filmed. In the ancient city of Split, modern gladiators compete.
Half-way to the world grand finals in Malaysia, in the home country of current leader Krzysztof Radzikowski, watch competitors battle it out for the SCL and ’The Strongest Man in Poland’titles.
The home country of the current world champion – Martin Wildauer. In the mountains of Austria competitors face the truck pull, yoke race, deadlift, frame walk, and dumbbell.

In the home of Drakula, Transylvania, competitors battle for the SCL champion title.

The Strongman Champions League Log Lift World Championships form part of the sport expo organised by Zydrunas Savickas., Fourteen competitors aim to top the ‘Big Z’s’ record lifting three different weights over their head.
In Vilnius, the city where one of the most powerful strongmen Žydr?nas Savickas lives, strongmen take on classics like tractor pulling and shield carrying. The ‘Big Z’ has won the title four times.

In Lithuania, Marius Lalas secured a second win, beating Grzegorz Szyma?ski. Both competitors now have two SCL victories overall. Will either of them secure a third win in Portugal before the World grand finals?
Next stop in our SCL caravan before the grand finale is paradise on Earth – Martinique. Eight strongmen from all over the World compete for the champion’s title and the World grand finals in Turkey.
The competition returns to Norway - one of the most beautiful countries on Earth. For the second time in this season, the country hosts the strongest men on the planet.
